About DINWEY

DINWEY is the truck and heavy-duty starting battery brand of Chengguang Energy, a manufacturer founded in 2002. We focus on one thing: starting batteries that hold up under the demands of commercial trucks — high cold cranking amps, vibration resistance, and consistent batch quality.

Our Focus

While many battery suppliers sell a broad catalog, DINWEY concentrates on the truck and heavy-duty vertical. That focus lets us go deep on what matters to commercial-vehicle buyers: correct group sizes (BCI Group 31, 8D, 4D; DIN H8/H9), diesel-grade CCA, and 12V vs 24V system requirements.

The Factory Behind the Brand

DINWEY is manufactured by Chengguang Energy, a battery manufacturer established in 2002 in Jinzhou City, Shijiazhuang, Hebei Province, China. We support OEM and private label programs for distributors, importers and brands worldwide.

Certification details are available on request. Contact us for current certificates relevant to your market.
